quote: Conversation generation models often use an encoder-decoder architecture to generate a response Y = {y 1 , ..., y n }.

ConceptFlow (Conversation generation with Concept Flow) ... leverages commonsense knowledge graphs to model the conversation flow ... Our experiments on a Reddit conversation dataset with a commonsense knowledge graph, ConceptNet, demonstrate the effectiveness of ConceptFlow.

The rapid advancements of language modeling and natural language generation (NLG) techniques have enabled fully data-driven conversation models, which directly generate natural language responses for conversations.

A wide range of evaluation metrics are used to evaluate the quality of generated responses: PPL (Serban et al., 2016), Bleu, Nist, ROUGE and Meteor are used for relevance and repetitiveness; Dist-1, Dist-2 and Ent-4 are used for diversity.

Human Evaluation. The human evaluation focuses on two aspects: appropriateness and informativeness. All responses of sampled 100 cases are selected from four methods ... The responses are scored from 1 to 4 by five judges.

All responses of sampled 100 cases are selected from four methods with better performances: CCM, GPT-2 (conv), ConceptFlow, and Golden Response. The responses are scored from 1 to 4 by five judges (the higher the better).
guideline: Appropriateness evaluates if the response is on-topic for the given utterance; informativeness evaluates systems' ability to provide new information instead of copying from the utterance.
Judges score each response on a 1‑4 scale for appropriateness (on‑topic) and informativeness (provides new information).

The responses are scored from 1 to 4 by five judges according to appropriateness and informativeness. Appropriateness evaluates if the response is on-topic for the given utterance; informativeness evaluates systems' ability to provide new information instead of copying from the utterance.
